reviews.author: Kevin B.
reviews.body: Good 4x4, punctual pickups in Marrakech, and a clean desert camp at Erg Chebbi. Our driver explained the history of Ait Ben Haddou and handled the long mountain driving comfortably.

reviews.author: Ben L.
reviews.body: Reliable transport across the High Atlas. Our driver kept a steady pace through the switchbacks and gave practical advice on what to pack for cold desert nights.

reviews.author: Sara M.
reviews.body: The private camp tents had hot showers and comfortable beds. Sunrise over the dunes was quiet and worth waking up early for.
